THE SPLIT PLATE / RECIPE

Split Plate TKS Sweet Heat Chicken Bowl

One air fryer batch of Crazy Cuizine, two completely different plates. Adults get crispy chicken tossed in TKS Sauce over Spicy Umami Fried Rice. Kids get plain crispy chicken with half-serving bone broth rice and raw sweet peppers — no spice, no glaze, no fried-rice complexity. The Costco frozen chicken is the protein anchor; the cookbook bases (bone broth rice + fried rice + TKS sauce) do all the upgrading.

YIELD4 servings
TOTAL TIME20 min (if bone broth rice is pre-made)
COOK METHODAir fryer
EST. / SERVING~400 cal | ~23g protein
KEY TO SUCCESS: BONE BROTH RICE MUST BE PRE-MADE AND COLD. The adult fried rice requires cold rice for texture. If you don't have it cold, make it the morning of and spread on a sheet pan to chill faster.

Ingredients

PROTEIN (one air fryer batch covers everyone)

  • 1 lb Crazy Cuizine Mandarin Orange Chicken (frozen, air-fryer ready)
  • *** Throw away the included orange-sauce packet — that's the whole reason this recipe exists ***

ADULT SIDE

  • 1 serving Spicy Umami Fried Rice (per adult) — made from cold bone broth rice

Option 1

  • Half serving Bone Broth Rice (microwave 60 sec with a splash of water)
  • 4-6 raw mini sweet peppers (Costco multicolor bag — red, orange, yellow)
  • Tiny ramekin of TKS Sauce on the side (most kids skip — sauce-as-dip pattern: it's there if they want to try it)

TIER 3 BASE (made ahead Sunday)

  • Bone Broth Rice (need 2.5 servings of the 8-serving batch — adult fried rice uses 2, kid plain uses 0.5)

ADULT GLAZE

  • 1/2 batch TKS Sauce (made while chicken cooks)

ADULT GARNISH (optional, recommended)

  • 1-2 scallions, sliced thin
  • 1 tsp toasted sesame seeds

Option 2

  • Half serving Bone Broth Rice (microwave 60 sec with a splash of water)
  • 4-6 raw mini sweet peppers (Costco multicolor bag — red, orange, yellow)
  • Tiny ramekin of TKS Sauce on the side (most kids skip — sauce-as-dip pattern: it's there if they want to try it)

Allergens: soy, gluten, sesame.

AFTER AIR FRYER. Pull kid portion (6 oz total) onto the kid tray BEFORE saucing the adult portion. Same air fryer batch, sauce only touches the adult chicken.

Method

Shared base

  1. 1.AIR FRY CHICKEN. 1 lb Crazy Cuizine, 400°F, 9-12 min from frozen, single layer, shake basket at 6 min. Pull when crispy + golden + edges crackle.
  2. 2.MAKE THE TKS SAUCE. While chicken air-fries (you have ~10 min). Whisk ginger-garlic paste + sesame chili oil + rice vinegar + soy + Bare Bones packet + hot honey sriracha. Full method in TKS Sauce (Cookbook).
  3. 3.MAKE THE FRIED RICE. While chicken cooks, fry the cold bone broth rice with egg + sauce per the Spicy Umami Fried Rice method. Use 2 servings of cold bone broth rice for 2 adults. Full method in Spicy Umami Fried Rice (Cookbook).
  4. 4.PULL KID CHICKEN. 6 oz (about half the cooked batch) onto the kid tray. No sauce yet. This is the split point.

Adult — TKS Sauced + Fried Rice

  1. 5.HOT DRY SKILLET. Medium-high heat, dry pan (no oil), screaming hot. Add the adult chicken (10 oz total, 5 oz per person).
  2. 6.GLAZE. Pour half a batch of TKS Sauce AROUND THE EDGE of the pan — the hiss is the cue. Toss aggressively 60-90 sec until every piece is glossy. Off heat when standing liquid is gone.
  3. 7.PLATE. Adult bowl — pile of Spicy Umami Fried Rice on one side, glossy TKS-glazed chicken on the other. Scatter scallions + sesame seeds across both. Real takeout dinner.

Kid — Plain Crispy + Half Rice + Sweet Peppers · Option 1

  1. 5.REHEAT KID RICE. Half serving plain bone broth rice in a small bowl, splash of water, microwave 60 sec covered with a damp paper towel.
  2. 6.SLICE PEPPERS. 4-6 mini sweet peppers cut into rings or sticks. Raw — kids prefer the crunch.
  3. 7.PLATE KID TRAY. 3 oz crispy chicken (no sauce) + half-serving plain bone broth rice (use a small ramekin and flip onto the plate as a rice mound — kids respond to playful shapes) + raw sweet peppers on the side. Optional tiny TKS Sauce ramekin as dip. Done.

Kid — Plain Crispy + Half Rice + Sweet Peppers · Option 2

  1. 5.PLATE. Just the 3 oz plain crispy chicken. Optionally with a folded tortilla or piece of bread on the side.

SPLIT PLATE SERVING

Adult — TKS Sauced + Fried Rice: Serve the adult portion as described above.

Kid — Plain Crispy + Half Rice + Sweet Peppers: Serve the kid portion as described above.

Keys to success

  • AIR FRY ONE BATCH for everyone: 1 lb Crazy Cuizine, 400°F, 9-12 min, single layer, shake basket halfway. Pull when crispy + golden.
  • PULL KID PORTION FIRST. 6 oz (about 2 small kids' worth) onto the kid tray BEFORE the adult chicken goes near sauce. No going back once it's glazed.

If something fails

Sauce slid off chicken instead of glazing: Pan wasn't hot enough. Medium-high, screaming hot, sauce around the edge of the pan (hissing immediately). Toss continuously — the cling builds over 60-90 sec, it's not instant.

Fried rice is mushy: Used warm rice. Bone broth rice MUST be cold. Make ahead, fridge overnight. The 8-serving Sunday batch is the architecture move.

Kid won't eat the chicken even plain: Crazy Cuizine breading has a slight tang. If your kid is sensitive, brush with butter + tiny pinch of salt after air-frying — totally neutralizes the breading flavor.

Kid plate looks beige: Add the raw mini sweet peppers. Costco multicolor mini sweet peppers (red, orange, yellow) are the Tier 4 fix — kids snack on them raw between bites of chicken. Don't cook them, kids prefer them crunchy.

Adults want more chicken / heavier portion: Use 6-7 oz per adult instead of 5. Top out at 8 oz max — at that point you've eaten a full Costco serving worth, the macros stop being honest.

Want to scale up to 4 adults instead of 2A+2K: Use full 1 lb chicken just for adults (4 × 4 oz portions) and a full batch of TKS Sauce. Make 2 batches of fried rice (uses 6 servings of bone broth rice — slightly less than the 8-serving Sunday batch).

Storage and reheating

Store: Best fresh. Cooked sauced chicken keeps 2 days but the glaze cling softens. Plain unsauced chicken (kid portion) holds longer.

Reheat: Air fryer 350°F for 3-4 min to re-crisp the breading. Microwave kills the texture.

Lasts: Fried rice 2-3 days. Sauced chicken 2 days. Plain chicken 3 days. Bone broth rice 5-6 days.

Estimated nutrition

~400 cal | ~23g protein.

Brands I use

Crazy Cuizine
Mandarin Orange Chicken (66 oz Costco party box, discard the packet)
Pre-cooked, pre-breaded, air-fryer ready in 9-12 min. The chicken itself is good — antibiotics-free, 13g protein per 3 oz. The orange-sauce packet is what's wrong with it. One Costco box = 4 dinners at this scale.
Bone Broth Rice
Cookbook base — pre-made Sunday
Tier 3 carb. 8-serving batch on Sunday powers this dinner (adult fried rice + kid plain rice), plus 5.5 servings of leftover rice for the rest of the week. This is the architecture move — never make rice on dinner night.
Spicy Umami Fried Rice
Cookbook base — adult side
Tier 3+2+1+4 stacked into one side. Uses 2 servings of cold bone broth rice for 2 adults. Made fresh while chicken air-fries.
TKS Sauce
Cookbook base — adult glaze
Tier 1 signature sauce. Replaces the discarded Crazy Cuizine orange packet. Hot-pan toss technique gives restaurant cling without cornstarch slurry.
